subject.title: feat(plugins): add Control UI entry points

question: Should plugin Control UI app-nav pages be a separate `registerControlUiEntryPoint` API with top-level open modes, or should launch-token behavior fold into the existing sandboxed tab descriptor seam?
rationale: This is a durable plugin SDK, Gateway protocol, and browser-security boundary; automation can point to unsafe defaults, but maintainers must choose the permanent API and trust model before external plugins depend on it.

options.title: Fold Into Tab Descriptor
options.body: Extend the existing `surface: "tab"` descriptor path with scoped launch behavior and keep plugin pages sandboxed by default.

options.title: Approve Separate API After Hardening
options.body: Keep `registerControlUiEntryPoint`, but remove or explicitly gate top-level open modes, use opaque iframe sandboxing, and fail closed on launch errors before merge.

options.title: Pause For RFC Consolidation
options.body: Leave the PR open while https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/66944 and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/71736 settle the native plugin page model.

recommendation.title: Fold Into Tab Descriptor
recommendation.body: Extend the existing `surface: "tab"` descriptor path with scoped launch behavior and keep plugin pages sandboxed by default.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the generic host-hook foundation and broader Control UI contribution RFC that best match the API-shape decision.
